comments.body: Aspen source slice landed via #2466: successful creep-upgrade purchases now show the authoritative new level/max, exact +health/+damage per-level effect, and remaining gold. Focused economy+upgrade contracts 27/27 PASS; hosted p3 contract gate SUCCESS. This closes the missing purchase-consequence communication slice; integrated match pacing/runtime acceptance remains with #2438.

PR #2477 makes the existing unaffordable shop state show the approximate passive-income wait derived from authoritative tick/cadence, while pointing to creep kills as the faster earn path. No economy tuning/authority change. Focused economy + gold-HUD contracts: 29/29 PASS; diff-check PASS.

Maple found a first-/third-person readability mismatch: creep health/level/damage/source labels still faced/scaled from pawn view, while recent opponent combat labels correctly use the actual PlayerCameraManager to account for third-person camera offset. #2539 / PR #2540 at c88109e4b applies the same camera-position rule with pawn-view fallback. Focused creep health/team/hit contracts 10/10 + diff-check PASS; hosted gate pending.

Follow-up #2541 / PR #2542 at 08c916010 closes the same third-person camera-offset mismatch for the in-world creep/upgrade shop labels: they now face/scale from PlayerCameraManager with pawn-view fallback. Focused economy/shop contracts 23/23 + diff-check PASS; hosted gate pending.

Aspen landed #2551 as 3f2e03cb5: repairs the merged third-person creep-label camera path's controller scope (current main had C2065 at the PlayerCameraManager access) while preserving actual-camera facing. Focused creep health/damage contracts 9/9 + diff-check + hosted gate passed. Remaining full-module native blocker is in the separately owned P3Construction/#2515 path.

Alder landed the player-visible purchase-pressure explanation through #2561 (world creep labels), #2563 (live HUD legend), #2565 (pre-match friend onboarding), and #2568 (successful purchase confirmation). Each reused existing economy/spawn authority and passed its focused contracts + hosted gate. #2570 aligns the ready/unaffordable buy-status wording and is pending its hosted gate. Integrated runtime acceptance remains separate/unclaimed.

Current-main transaction audit: shop authority correctly rechecks team/match/max-level/balance and refunds a failed creep spawn, but the purchase API has no request identity/sequence. `AP3TowerDefenseLaneWarShopActor::Interact` directly calls `AuthorityTryPurchaseLaneWarCreep*`, and each accepted call spends again if the player still has enough gold. Existing tests cover insufficient gold, max upgrade, rematch reset and one successful purchase, but not duplicate/stale request rejection. Therefore the issue acceptance for duplicate/stale purchase requests is still unproven and structurally absent; fix it at the existing authoritative shop transaction path, not in UI wording.

Correction/refinement to my previous transaction note after tracing the controller RPC: the client does not send a shop target, offer, cost, balance, or purchase payload at all. `ServerTryInteract()` is Reliable and the server resolves the current in-range visible interactable, then `CanInteract`/`Interact` revalidate current team/match/max-level/balance. So stale/forged purchase payloads are structurally excluded by this path, and transport retransmission is handled by UE's reliable RPC semantics. The remaining acceptance gap is narrower: prove that repeated distinct interaction presses cannot create an unintended double-spend/duplicate effect under the recorded network-emulation profile, rather than adding an application request-ID mechanism without evidence it is needed.

Current-main source-derived economy baseline at 3c312eff5731, for the requested matched-state tuning comparison: passive income is 1 gold / 2s; extra creep costs 20 gold; creep upgrade costs 50; creep kill reward is 5. With passive income only, first extra-pressure purchase is affordable at ~40s and first upgrade at ~100s; each 5-gold creep reward advances either decision by ~10s of passive time. Base creep stats are 100 health / 20 attack damage; each upgrade level adds +25 health and +5 damage, so level 1 is 125 health / 25 damage (+25% each). This establishes the deterministic starting comparison only. Actual before/after lane pressure, purchase opportunity timing under combat income, and time-to-win still require the normal-match runtime baseline requested by this issue; no balance claim from constants alone.

One additional source-level pacing bound from the same constants: max creep upgrade level is 5, so buying all five upgrades costs 250 gold. Passive-only time to fund the full chain is ~500s; level 5 yields 225 health and 45 attack damage from the 100/20 base. That makes the first 50-gold upgrade the relevant short-match comparison; full-chain balance should not be inferred or tuned before the requested normal-match runtime baseline.
